name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.actAux_spec
statement:
lemma actAux_spec (m : ℕ) : ∀ s : σ →₀ ℕ, s.degree = m → ∀ i : σ,
    (∀ n, m ≤ n → actAux b n i s = rho b (b i) (z R σ s)) ∧
      rho b (b i) (z R σ s) - z R σ (s + single i 1) ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R m

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.actAux_succ
statement:
lemma actAux_succ (n : ℕ) (i : σ) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    actAux b (n + 1) i s =
      if h : LeAll i s then z R σ (s + single i 1) else
        opAux b n (b (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)))
          (opAux b n (b i) (z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1)) -
            z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1 + single i 1)) +
          z R σ (s + single i 1) +
          opAux b n ⁅b i, b (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h))⁆
            (z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.comm_of_basis
statement:
lemma comm_of_basis {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : ∀ i j, rho b (b i) (rho b (b j) p) - rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) p) =
      rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ p) (x y : L) :
    rho b x (rho b y p) - rho b y (rho b x p) = rho b ⁅x, y⁆ p

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.comm_of_leAll
statement:
lemma comm_of_leAll {i j : σ} {t : σ →₀ ℕ} (ht : LeAll j t) (hji : j < i) :
    rho b (b i) (rho b (b j) (z R σ t)) - rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ t)) =
      rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ t)

statement:

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rho_of_not_leAll
statement:
lemma rho_of_not_leAll {i : σ} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : ¬ LeAll i s) :
    rho b (b i) (z R σ s) =
      rho b (b (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)))
          (rho b (b i) (z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1)) -
            z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1 + single i 1)) +
        z R σ (s + single i 1) +
        rho b ⁅b i, b (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h))⁆
          (z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1))

name: Module.Dual.exists_prod_pow_eq_C_mul_prod_pow
statement:
theorem exists_prod_pow_eq_C_mul_prod_pow {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) {a : κ → H} (c : κ → K)

    (h : ∀ k₀ ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ s with AffProportional (a k) (c k) (a k₀) (c k₀), e k =
      ∑ k ∈ s with AffProportional (a k) (c k) (a k₀) (c k₀), f k) :
    ∃ u : K, u ≠ 0 ∧ ∏ k ∈ s, affPoly K H (a k) (c k) ^ e k =

theorem gaussBinom_add_mul_add_mul (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) {a₀ t₀ : ℕ}
    (ha₀ : a₀ < l) (ht₀ : t₀ < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    gaussBinom v (a₀ + l * a₁) (t₀ + l * t₁) =
      ((v ^ ((a₀ * t₁ - a₁ * t₀) * l + (a₁ + 1) * t₁ * (l : ℤ) ^ 2) : Rˣ) : R) *
        gaussBinom v a₀ t₀ * ((Ring.choose a₁ t₁ : ℤ) : R)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_mul_mul
statement:
theorem gaussBinom_mul_mul (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    gaussBinom v (l * a₁) (l * t₁) =
      ((v ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * (a₁ + 1) * t₁) : Rˣ) : R) * ((Ring.choose a₁ t₁ : ℤ) : R)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_natCast
statement: @[simp] lemma gaussBinom_natCast (n t : ℕ) : gaussBinom v n t = qBinomialU v n t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_gaussBinom
statement:
lemma map_gaussBinom {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    φ (gaussBinom v a t) = gaussBinom (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom v) a t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_gaussBinom_field
statement:
lemma map_gaussBinom_field {k : Type*} [Field k] (φ : R →+* k) (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    φ (gaussBinom v a t) = qBinomInt (φ v) a t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_units_zpow
statement:
lemma map_units_zpow {k : Type*} [Field k] (φ : R →+* k) (z : ℤ) :
    φ ((v ^ z : Rˣ) : R) = φ v ^ z

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_sq_add_eq
statement:
theorem pow_sq_add_eq (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1) (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1)
    (hl0 : 0 < l) : q ^ (l ^ 2 + l) = (-1) ^ (l + 1)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_sq_add_eq_of_root
statement:
theorem pow_sq_add_eq_of_root (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) :
    (v : R) ^ (l ^ 2 + l) = (-1) ^ (l + 1)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_add
statement:
theorem qBinomIntSeries_add (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b : ℤ) :
    qBinomIntSeries q (a + b) =
      rescale (q ^ (-b)) (qBinomIntSeries q a) * rescale (q ^ a) (qBinomIntSeries q b)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_add_one
statement:
theorem qBinomIntSeries_add_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (a : ℤ) :
    qBinomIntSeries q (a + 1) = (1 + C (q ^ a) * X) * rescale q⁻¹ (qBinomIntSeries q a)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_eq_of_root
statement:
theorem qBinomIntSeries_eq_of_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) :
    qBinomIntSeries q l = 1 + X ^ l

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_mul_add_one
statement:
lemma qBinomIntSeries_mul_add_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (m : ℤ) :
    qBinomIntSeries q (l * (m + 1)) = rescale (q ^ (-(l : ℤ))) (qBinomIntSeries q (l * m)) *
      (1 + C (q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * m)) * X ^ l)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_mul_eq
statement:
theorem qBinomIntSeries_mul_eq (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (m : ℤ) :
    qBinomIntSeries q (l * m) = rootSeries q l hl0 m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomIntSeries_zero : qBinomIntSeries q 0 = 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_add
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_add (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (a + b) t = ∑ i ∈ range (t + 1),
      q ^ (a * (t - i : ℕ) - b * i) * qBinomInt q a i * qBinomInt q b (t - i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) {a₀ t₀ : ℕ} (ha₀ : a₀ < l)
    (ht₀ : t₀ < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (a₀ + l * a₁) (t₀ + l * t₁) =
      q ^ ((a₀ * t₁ - a₁ * t₀) * l + (a₁ + 1) * t₁ * (l : ℤ) ^ 2) * qBinomial q a₀ t₀ *
        ((Ring.choose a₁ t₁ : ℤ) : k)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul_eq
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul_eq (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) {a₀ t₀ : ℕ} (ha₀ : a₀ < l)
    (ht₀ : t₀ < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (a₀ + l * a₁) (t₀ + l * t₁) =
      q ^ ((l : ℤ) * a₀ * t₁ - l * a₁ * t₀) * qBinomial q a₀ t₀ *
        qBinomInt q (l * a₁) (l * t₁)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) {a : ℤ} (ha : (l : ℤ) ∣ a)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : ¬ l ∣ t) : qBinomInt q a t = 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_inv
statement: lemma qBinomInt_inv (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) : qBinomInt q⁻¹ a t = qBinomInt q a t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_mul_mul
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_mul_mul (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (l * a₁) (l * t₁) =
      q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * (a₁ + 1) * t₁) * ((Ring.choose a₁ t₁ : ℤ) : k)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_natCast
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomInt_natCast (n t : ℕ) : qBinomInt q n t = qBinomial q n t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_negSucc
statement:
lemma qBinomInt_negSucc (n t : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (Int.negSucc n) t = (-1) ^ t * qBinomial q (n + t) t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomInt_zero_right (a : ℤ) : qBinomInt q a 0 = 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialInvSeries_inv
statement: lemma qBinomialInvSeries_inv (h : ℕ) : qBinomialInvSeries q⁻¹ h = qBinomialInvSeries q h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialU_map
statement:
lemma qBinomialU_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (n t : ℕ) :
    φ (qBinomialU v n t) = qBinomialU (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom v) n t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_eq_zero_of_root
statement:
theorem qBinomial_eq_zero_of_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) {t : ℕ} (ht0 : 0 < t) (htl : t < l) :
    qBinomial q l t = 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_C'
statement: lemma rescale_C' (a c : k) : rescale a (C c) = C c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_expand
statement:
lemma rescale_expand (c : k) (f : PowerSeries k) (hl0 : 0 < l) :
    rescale c (expand l hl0.ne' f) = expand l hl0.ne' (rescale (c ^ l) f)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_one_add_X_pow
statement:
lemma rescale_one_add_X_pow (c : k) :
    rescale c (1 + X ^ l : PowerSeries k) = 1 + C (c ^ l) * X ^ l

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_qBinomIntSeries_add_one
statement:
lemma rescale_qBinomIntSeries_add_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b : ℤ) :
    rescale (q ^ (-(b + 1))) (qBinomIntSeries q a) * rescale (q ^ a) (qBinomIntSeries q (b + 1)) =
      (1 + C (q ^ (a + b)) * X) * rescale q⁻¹
        (rescale (q ^ (-b)) (qBinomIntSeries q a) * rescale (q ^ a) (qBinomIntSeries q b))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootSeries_add_one
statement:
lemma rootSeries_add_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (m : ℤ) :
    rootSeries q l hl0 (m + 1) =
      rescale (q ^ (-(l : ℤ))) (rootSeries q l hl0 m) *
        (1 + C (q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * m)) * X ^ l)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootSeries_zero
statement: lemma rootSeries_zero (hl0 : 0 < l) : rootSeries q l hl0 0 = 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_eq_of_dvd
statement:
lemma zpow_eq_of_dvd (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1) {z z' : ℤ}
    (h : 2 * (l : ℤ) ∣ z - z') : q ^ z = q ^ z'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_mul_mul_eq_pow
statement:
theorem gaussBinom_mul_mul_eq_pow (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    gaussBinom v (l * a₁) (l * t₁) = gaussBinom (v ^ (l ^ 2)) a₁ t₁

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.prod_qBinomialU_mul_root
statement:
theorem prod_qBinomialU_mul_root (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (p : ℕ) :
    ∏ j ∈ range p, qBinomialU v (l * (j + 1)) l =
      (p.factorial : R) * (v : R) ^ (l ^ 2 * p.choose 2)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.prod_qBinomial_mul_root
statement:
theorem prod_qBinomial_mul_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (p : ℕ) :
    ∏ j ∈ range p, qBinomial q (l * (j + 1)) l = (p.factorial : k) * q ^ (l ^ 2 * p.choose 2)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_mul_eq
statement:
theorem qFactorial_mul_eq (q : k) (l p : ℕ) :
    qFactorial q (l * p) =
      (∏ j ∈ range p, qBinomial q (l * (j + 1)) l) * qFactorial q l ^ p

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_neg_one_pow_qBinomial
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_qBinomial (hq : q ≠ 0) (n m : ℕ) :
    ∑ s ∈ range (m + 1), (-1) ^ s * q ^ (-((s : ℤ) * n)) * qBinomial q (n + 1) s =
      (-1) ^ m * q ^ (-((m : ℤ) * (n + 1))) * qBinomial q n m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_qBinomialU_root
statement:
theorem sum_qBinomialU_root (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) {r a : ℕ} (hra : r ≤ a)
    (hal : a < l) :
    ∑ s ∈ range (l - a), (-1) ^ (l - r + 1 + s) *
        ((v ^ (-(((l : ℤ) - r) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1 + s)) + s) : Rˣ) : R) *
          qBinomialU v (l - r) s =
      ((v ^ ((l : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - r)) : Rˣ) : R) * qBinomialU v a r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_qBinomial_root
statement:
theorem sum_qBinomial_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) {r a : ℕ} (hra : r ≤ a) (hal : a < l) :
    ∑ s ∈ range (l - a), (-1) ^ (l - r + 1 + s) *
        q ^ (-(((l : ℤ) - r) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1 + s)) + s) * qBinomial q (l - r) s =
      q ^ ((l : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - r)) * qBinomial q a r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_frobSerreCoeff
statement:
theorem sum_frobSerreCoeff (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * L) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < L → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hL : 0 < L) {N : ℕ} (hN : L ∣ N)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ N + L) :
    ∑ t ∈ range L, ((-1) ^ t * q ^ (((N : ℤ) + L - 1) * t)) *
        ((-1) ^ r * q ^ ((r : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1 - t)) * qBinomial q (N + L - r) t) =
      if L ∣ r then (-1) ^ (r / L) else 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_neg_one_pow_zpow_qBinomial
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_zpow_qBinomial (hq : q ≠ 0) {a : ℕ} (haL : a < L) :
    ∑ t ∈ range L, (-1) ^ t * q ^ ((t : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - 1)) * qBinomial q a t =
      if a = 0 then 1 else 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_mul_sub_one_eq
statement:
lemma zpow_mul_sub_one_eq (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * L) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < L → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hL : 0 < L) :
    q ^ ((L : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1)) = (-1) ^ (L + 1)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.algebraMap_mem_weightSpace

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.counit_algebraMap
statement: @[simp] lemma counit_algebraMap (c : k) : counit (algebraMap k (LusztigF k I) c) = c

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.counit_diagTwist
statement:
@[simp] lemma counit_diagTwist (c : I → k) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    counit (diagTwist c x) = counit x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.counit_rDeriv_θ_mul
statement:
lemma counit_rDeriv_θ_mul (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    counit (rDeriv D v i (θ k j * x)) = if i = j then counit x else 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.counit_twist
statement: @[simp] lemma counit_twist (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : counit (twist D v i x) = counit x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.counit_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma counit_θ (i : I) : counit (θ k i) = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.diagTwist_comm
statement:
lemma diagTwist_comm (c c' : I → k) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    diagTwist c (diagTwist c' x) = diagTwist c' (diagTwist c x)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.diagTwist_diagTwist
statement:
lemma diagTwist_diagTwist (c c' : I → k) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    diagTwist c (diagTwist c' x) = diagTwist (c * c') x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.diagTwist_one
statement: @[simp] lemma diagTwist_one (x : LusztigF k I) : diagTwist (fun _ ↦ (1 : k)) x = x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.diagTwist_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma diagTwist_θ (c : I → k) (j : I) : diagTwist c (θ k j) = c j • θ k j

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.finite_setOf_wordWeight_eq
statement: lemma finite_setOf_wordWeight_eq (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : {w : List I | wordWeight w = ν}.Finite

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.gradingHom_monomial
statement:
lemma gradingHom_monomial (w : List I) :
    gradingHom k I (monomial k w) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (wordWeight w) (monomial k w)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.gradingHom_of_mem
statement:
lemma gradingHom_of_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) :
    gradingHom k I x = AddMonoidAlgebra.single ν x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.iSupIndep_weightSpace
statement: theorem iSupIndep_weightSpace : iSupIndep (weightSpace k (I := I))

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.iSup_weightSpace
statement: theorem iSup_weightSpace : ⨆ ν, weightSpace k (I := I) ν = ⊤

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.induction_left
statement:
theorem induction_left {P : LusztigF k I → Prop} (algebraMap : ∀ c, P (algebraMap k _ c))
    (smul : ∀ (c : k) x, P x → P (c • x)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (θ_mul : ∀ i x, P x → P (θ k i * x)) (x : LusztigF k I) : P x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.induction_right
statement:
theorem induction_right {P : LusztigF k I → Prop} (algebraMap : ∀ c, P (algebraMap k _ c))
    (smul : ∀ (c : k) x, P x → P (c • x)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (mul_θ : ∀ x i, P x → P (x * θ k i)) (x : LusztigF k I) : P x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lDeriv_algebraMap
statement: @[simp] lemma lDeriv_algebraMap (i : I) (c : k) : lDeriv D v i (algebraMap k _ c) = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lDeriv_apply
statement: lemma lDeriv_apply (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : lDeriv D v i x = lMat D v i x 0 1

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lDeriv_diagTwist
statement:
lemma lDeriv_diagTwist (c : I → k) (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (diagTwist c x) = c i • diagTwist c (lDeriv D v i x)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem lDeriv_mul (i : I) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (x * y) = lDeriv D v i x * y + twist D v i x * lDeriv D v i y

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lDeriv_one
statement: @[simp] lemma lDeriv_one (i : I) : lDeriv D v i 1 = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lDeriv_twist
statement:
lemma lDeriv_twist (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (twist D v j x) = v ^ D.dot i j • twist D v j (lDeriv D v i x)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lDeriv_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma lDeriv_θ (i j : I) : lDeriv D v i (θ k j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lDeriv_θ_mul
statement:
lemma lDeriv_θ_mul (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (θ k j * x) =
      (if i = j then x else 0) + v ^ D.dot i j • (θ k j * lDeriv D v i x)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.lMat_entries
statement:
lemma lMat_entries (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lMat D v i x 0 0 = twist D v i x ∧ lMat D v i x 1 0 = 0 ∧ lMat D v i x 1 1 = x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.length_eq_sum_wordWeight
statement: lemma length_eq_sum_wordWeight (w : List I) : w.length = (wordWeight w).sum fun _ n ↦ n

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.monomial_append
statement:

    monomial k (w ++ w') = monomial k w * monomial k w'

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.monomial_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma monomial_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :
    monomial k (i :: w) = θ k i * monomial k w

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.monomial_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma monomial_mem_weightSpace (w : List I) : monomial k w ∈ weightSpace k (wordWeight w)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.monomial_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma monomial_nil : monomial k ([] : List I) = 1

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.mul_mem_weightSpace
statement:

    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k μ) : x * y ∈ weightSpace k (ν + μ)

statement: lemma one_mem_weightSpace : (1 : LusztigF k I) ∈ weightSpace k 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_algebraMap
statement: @[simp] lemma rDeriv_algebraMap (i : I) (c : k) : rDeriv D v i (algebraMap k _ c) = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_apply

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_diagTwist
statement:
lemma rDeriv_diagTwist (c : I → k) (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (diagTwist c x) = c i • diagTwist c (rDeriv D v i x)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem rDeriv_mul (i : I) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (x * y) = x * rDeriv D v i y + rDeriv D v i x * twist D v i y

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_mul_θ
statement:
lemma rDeriv_mul_θ (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (x * θ k j) =
      (if i = j then x else 0) + v ^ D.dot i j • (rDeriv D v i x * θ k j)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_one
statement: @[simp] lemma rDeriv_one (i : I) : rDeriv D v i 1 = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_twist
statement:
lemma rDeriv_twist (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (twist D v j x) = v ^ D.dot i j • twist D v j (rDeriv D v i x)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma rDeriv_θ (i j : I) : rDeriv D v i (θ k j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rDeriv_θ_mul
statement:
lemma rDeriv_θ_mul (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (θ k j * x) = θ k j * rDeriv D v i x + if i = j then twist D v i x else 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.rMat_entries
statement:
lemma rMat_entries (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rMat D v i x 0 0 = x ∧ rMat D v i x 1 0 = 0 ∧ rMat D v i x 1 1 = twist D v i x

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.span_monomial
statement: lemma span_monomial : Submodule.span k (Set.range (monomial k (I := I))) = ⊤

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twist_comm
statement:
lemma twist_comm (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    twist D v i (twist D v j x) = twist D v j (twist D v i x)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twist_eq_diagTwist
statement: lemma twist_eq_diagTwist (i : I) : twist D v i = diagTwist fun j ↦ v ^ D.dot i j

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twist_of_mem
Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twist_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma twist_θ (i j : I) : twist D v i (θ k j) = v ^ D.dot i j • θ k j

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.wordWeight_append
statement:
lemma wordWeight_append (w w' : List I) :
    wordWeight (w ++ w') = wordWeight w + wordWeight w'

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.wordWeight_apply
statement:
lemma wordWeight_apply (w : List I) (i : I) [DecidableEq I] :
    wordWeight w i = w.count i

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.wordWeight_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma wordWeight_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :
    wordWeight (i :: w) = Finsupp.single i 1 + wordWeight w

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.wordWeight_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordWeight_nil : wordWeight ([] : List I) = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.θ_mem_weightSpace

name: FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv_mapCoeffs

name: FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapCoeffs_algebraMap (c : R) :
    mapCoeffs φ (algebraMap R (FreeAlgebra R X) c) = algebraMap S _ (φ c)

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_eq_sum
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_eq_sum (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ x = ((wordBasis R X).repr x).sum fun w c ↦ φ c • wordBasis S X w

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_smul
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_smul (c : R) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (c • x) = φ c • mapCoeffs φ x

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_wordBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapCoeffs_wordBasis (w : List X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (wordBasis R X w) = wordBasis S X w

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_ι
statement: @[simp] lemma mapCoeffs_ι (x : X) : mapCoeffs φ (ι R x) = ι S x

name: FreeAlgebra.span_wordBasis
statement: lemma span_wordBasis : Submodule.span R (Set.range (wordBasis R X)) = ⊤

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_append
statement:
lemma wordBasis_append (w w' : List X) :
    wordBasis R X (w ++ w') = wordBasis R X w * wordBasis R X w'

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma wordBasis_apply (w : List X) : wordBasis R X w = (w.map (ι R)).prod

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma wordBasis_mem_wordSpan (w : List X) :
    wordBasis R X w ∈ wordSpan R (LusztigF.wordWeight w)

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq
statement:
lemma wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq {w : List X} {μ : X →₀ ℕ} (h : LusztigF.wordWeight w = μ) :
    wordBasis R X w ∈ wordSpan R μ

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordBasis_nil : wordBasis R X [] = 1

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_repr_mapCoeffs
statement:
theorem wordBasis_repr_mapCoeffs (x : FreeAlgebra R X) (w : List X) :
    (wordBasis S X).repr (mapCoeffs φ x) w = φ ((wordBasis R X).repr x w)

name: FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction
statement:
theorem wordSpan_induction {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {P : (x : FreeAlgebra R X) → x ∈ wordSpan R μ → Prop}
    (word : ∀ w (hw : LusztigF.wordWeight w = μ),
      P (wordBasis R X w) (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq hw))
    (zero : P 0 (zero_mem _))
    (add : ∀ x y hx hy, P x hx → P y hy → P (x + y) (add_mem hx hy))
    (smul : ∀ (c : R) x hx, P x hx → P (c • x) (Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx))
    {x : FreeAlgebra R X} (hx : x ∈ wordSpan R μ) : P x hx

name: FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma ι_mul_mem_wordSpan (x : X) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :

name: FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis
statement:
lemma ι_mul_wordBasis (x : X) (w : List X) :
    ι R x * wordBasis R X w = wordBasis R X (x :: w)

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem
statement: lemma weightProj_mem (ν : X →₀ ℕ) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) : weightProj R ν x ∈ wordSpan R ν

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mul_wordBasis
statement:
lemma weightProj_mul_wordBasis (ν : X →₀ ℕ) (b : List X) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    weightProj R ν (x * wordBasis R X b) =
      if LusztigF.wordWeight b ≤ ν then
        weightProj R (ν - LusztigF.wordWeight b) x * wordBasis R X b else 0

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mul_ι_pow
statement:
lemma weightProj_mul_ι_pow {ν : X →₀ ℕ} {i : X} {N : ℕ} (h : ν i < N)
    (x : FreeAlgebra R X) : weightProj R ν (x * ι R i ^ N) = 0

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_of_mem
statement:
lemma weightProj_of_mem {ν μ : X →₀ ℕ} {x : FreeAlgebra R X} (hx : x ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    weightProj R ν x = if μ = ν then x else 0

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_self
statement:
lemma weightProj_self {ν : X →₀ ℕ} {x : FreeAlgebra R X} (hx : x ∈ wordSpan R ν) :
    weightProj R ν x = x

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis
statement:
lemma weightProj_wordBasis (ν : X →₀ ℕ) (w : List X) :
    weightProj R ν (wordBasis R X w) = if LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν then wordBasis R X w else 0

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis_mul
statement:
lemma weightProj_wordBasis_mul (ν : X →₀ ℕ) (a : List X) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    weightProj R ν (wordBasis R X a * x) =
      if LusztigF.wordWeight a ≤ ν then
        wordBasis R X a * weightProj R (ν - LusztigF.wordWeight a) x else 0

name: FreeAlgebra.wordWeight_add_eq_iff
statement: lemma wordWeight_add_eq_iff {a b ν : X →₀ ℕ} : a + b = ν ↔ a ≤ ν ∧ b = ν - a

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.mul_wordBasis_mem_serreSpan

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.serreProduct_mem

lemma serreProduct_mem_serreSpan {g : List I × I × I × List I} (hg : g.2.1 ≠ g.2.2.1) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.serreWord_mem

Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.wordBasis_mul_mem_serreSpan

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_of_sq_eq_one

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.finrank_serreSpan_of_sq_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_serreSpan_of_sq_eq_one {q : I → K} (hq : ∀ i, q i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hsym : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → q i ^ (serreExp D i j - 1) = q j ^ (serreExp D j i - 1))

statement:
lemma pow_mul_mul_pow (i j : I) (m r : ℕ) :

      wordBasis K I (List.replicate (m - r) i ++ j :: List.replicate r i)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signCross_perm_left
statement:
lemma signCross_perm_left {u u' w : List I} (h : u.Perm u') :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signCross_perm_right
statement:
lemma signCross_perm_right {u w w' : List I} (h : w.Perm w') :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signCross_sq
statement: lemma signCross_sq (hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1) (u w : List I) : signCross σ u w ^ 2 = 1

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signTwist_serreProduct
statement:
lemma signTwist_serreProduct {q : I → K} (hq : ∀ i, q i ^ 2 = 1) (hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1)
    (hσd : ∀ i, σ i i = 1)
    (hσq : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → σ i j * σ j i = q i ^ (serreExp D i j - 1))
    {g : List I × I × I × List I} (hg : g.2.1 ≠ g.2.2.1) :
    ∃ s : K, s ≠ 0 ∧ signTwist σ (serreProduct D q g) =
      s • serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) g

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signTwist_signTwist
statement:
lemma signTwist_signTwist (hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1) (x : LusztigF K I) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signTwist_wordBasis
statement:
lemma signTwist_wordBasis (w : List I) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signWord_append
statement:
lemma signWord_append (u w : List I) :
    signWord σ (u ++ w) = signWord σ u * signWord σ w * signCross σ u w

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signWord_cons
statement:
lemma signWord_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma signWord_nil : signWord σ [] = 1

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signWord_replicate

lemma signWord_replicate (hσ : ∀ i, σ i i = 1) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signWord_serre
statement:
lemma signWord_serre (hσ : ∀ i, σ i i = 1) (i j : I) (m r : ℕ) :
    signWord σ (List.replicate (m - r) i ++ j :: List.replicate r i) =
      σ i j ^ (m - r) * σ j i ^ r

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.signWord_sq
statement: lemma signWord_sq (hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1) (w : List I) : signWord σ w ^ 2 = 1

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.mapCoeffs_vermaOp

theorem mapCoeffs_vermaOp (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.mapCoeffs_vermaOpWord

lemma mapCoeffs_vermaOpWord (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.mapCoeffs_vermaWordOp
statement:
theorem mapCoeffs_vermaWordOp (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.map_vermaForm
statement:
theorem map_vermaForm (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.single_add_tsub_single

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaForm_apply
statement:
lemma vermaForm_apply (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaForm_cons

lemma vermaForm_cons (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (i : X) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaForm_eq_zero_of_ne
Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaForm_nil

@[simp] lemma vermaForm_nil (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaOpWord_eq_zero

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaOpWord_mem

lemma vermaOpWord_mem (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaOp_mem_wordSpan
statement:

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaOp_one
statement: @[simp] lemma vermaOp_one (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) : vermaOp i c 1 = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaOp_wordBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma vermaOp_wordBasis (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaOp_ι_mul
statement:
theorem vermaOp_ι_mul (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (j : X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    vermaOp i c (ι R j * y) = ι R j * vermaOp i c y + if i = j then weightScale c y else 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaWordOp_cons
statement:
lemma vermaWordOp_cons (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (i : X) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    vermaWordOp c (i :: w) y = vermaWordOp c w (vermaOp i (c i) y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaWordOp_mem
statement:
lemma vermaWordOp_mem (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra R X}
    (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    vermaWordOp c w y ∈ wordSpan R (μ - wordWeight w) ∧
      (¬ wordWeight w ≤ μ → vermaWordOp c w y = 0)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.vermaWordOp_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma vermaWordOp_nil (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) : vermaWordOp c [] = 1

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.weightScale_of_mem
statement:
lemma weightScale_of_mem (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra R X}

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.weightScale_wordBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma weightScale_wordBasis (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    weightScale c (wordBasis R X w) = c (wordWeight w) • wordBasis R X w

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.eq_algebraMap_of_mem_wordSpan_zero
statement:
lemma eq_algebraMap_of_mem_wordSpan_zero {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R 0) :
    y = algebraMap R _ (algebraMapInv y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.mapCoeffs_twistVermaOp
statement:
theorem mapCoeffs_twistVermaOp (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (twistVermaOp i s c y) = twistVermaOp i (φ ∘ s) (φ ∘ c) (mapCoeffs φ y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.mapCoeffs_twistVermaOpWord
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_twistVermaOpWord (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (twistVermaOpWord i s c w) = twistVermaOpWord i (φ ∘ s) (φ ∘ c) w

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.mapCoeffs_twistVermaWordOp
statement:
theorem mapCoeffs_twistVermaWordOp (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (twistVermaWordOp s c w y) =
      twistVermaWordOp (fun i ↦ φ ∘ s i) (fun i ↦ φ ∘ c i) w (mapCoeffs φ y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.map_twistVermaForm
statement:
theorem map_twistVermaForm (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    φ (twistVermaForm s c w y) =
      twistVermaForm (fun i ↦ φ ∘ s i) (fun i ↦ φ ∘ c i) w (mapCoeffs φ y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaForm_apply
statement:
lemma twistVermaForm_apply (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaForm s c w y = algebraMapInv (twistVermaWordOp s c w y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaForm_cons
statement:
lemma twistVermaForm_cons (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (i : X) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaForm s c (i :: w) y = twistVermaForm s c w (twistVermaOp i (s i) (c i) y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaForm_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem twistVermaForm_eq_zero_of_ne (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    {μ : X →₀ ℕ} (hμ : wordWeight w ≠ μ) {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    twistVermaForm s c w y = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaForm_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem twistVermaForm_mul_coeff (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (κ : X → R)
    (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaForm s (fun i μ ↦ κ i * c i μ) w y = (w.map κ).prod * twistVermaForm s c w y

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOpWord_eq_zero
statement:
lemma twistVermaOpWord_eq_zero (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    (hw : wordWeight w i = 0) : twistVermaOpWord i s c w = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOpWord_mem
statement:
lemma twistVermaOpWord_mem (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    twistVermaOpWord i s c w ∈ wordSpan R (wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma twistVermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) {μ : X →₀ ℕ}
    (hμ : μ i = 0) {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) : twistVermaOp i s c y = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOp_mem_wordSpan
Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOp_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem twistVermaOp_mul_coeff (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (κ : R) :
    twistVermaOp i s (fun μ ↦ κ * c μ) = κ • twistVermaOp i s c

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOp_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma twistVermaOp_one (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) :
    twistVermaOp i s c 1 = 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOp_one_sign
statement:
theorem twistVermaOp_one_sign (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) :
    twistVermaOp i (fun _ ↦ 1) c = vermaOp i c

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOp_wordBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma twistVermaOp_wordBasis (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    twistVermaOp i s c (wordBasis R X w) = twistVermaOpWord i s c w

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaOp_ι_mul
statement:
theorem twistVermaOp_ι_mul (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (j : X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaOp i s c (ι R j * y) =
      s j • (ι R j * twistVermaOp i s c y) + if i = j then weightScale c y else 0

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaWordOp_cons
statement:
lemma twistVermaWordOp_cons (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (i : X) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaWordOp s c (i :: w) y = twistVermaWordOp s c w (twistVermaOp i (s i) (c i) y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaWordOp_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem twistVermaWordOp_eq_algebraMap (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R (wordWeight w)) :
    twistVermaWordOp s c w y = algebraMap R _ (twistVermaForm s c w y)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaWordOp_mem
statement:
lemma twistVermaWordOp_mem (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) {μ : X →₀ ℕ}
    {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    twistVermaWordOp s c w y ∈ wordSpan R (μ - wordWeight w) ∧
      (¬ wordWeight w ≤ μ → twistVermaWordOp s c w y = 0)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.LusztigF.twistVermaWordOp_nil
statement:
@[simp] lemma twistVermaWordOp_nil (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) :
    twistVermaWordOp s c [] = 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_relations
statement:
theorem counit_relations :
    Relations R v (0 : I → k) (0 : I → k) (1 : Multiplicative Y →* k)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_tmul_left
statement:
lemma qSerre_tmul_left (ν : k) (M : ℕ) {g h : A} (hgh : Commute g h) (a b : B) :
    qSerre ν M (g ⊗ₜ[k] a) (h ⊗ₜ[k] b) = (g ^ M * h) ⊗ₜ qSerre ν M a b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_tmul_right
statement:
lemma qSerre_tmul_right (ν : k) (M : ℕ) {g h : B} (hgh : Commute g h) (a b : A) :
    qSerre ν M (a ⊗ₜ[k] g) (b ⊗ₜ[k] h) = qSerre ν M a b ⊗ₜ (g ^ M * h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_root_ktilde_eq
LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_root_ktilde_self
statement: lemma zpow_root_ktilde_self (i : I) : v ^ R.root i (ktilde R i) = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.inv_pow_sub
statement: lemma inv_pow_sub {r u : ℕ} (h : u ≤ r) : q⁻¹ ^ (r - u) = q⁻¹ ^ r * q ^ u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.neg_one_pow_sub
statement: lemma neg_one_pow_sub {r u : ℕ} (h : u ≤ r) : (-1 : k) ^ (r - u) = (-1) ^ r * (-1) ^ u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.psi_coeff
statement:
lemma psi_coeff {p r kk : ℕ} (hk : kk ≤ r) (hh : r ≤ p + kk) :
    (-1) ^ p * q ^ p * ∑ s ∈ range (r + 1), (if s ≤ p then (-1) ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ s else 0) *
      (qBinomial q (p - s + kk) (p - s) * qBinomial q kk (r - s)) =
      (-1) ^ (p + kk - r) * q ^ ((p + kk - r) * (kk + 1))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq
statement:
lemma qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq {a kk u : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ kk) :
    qBinomial q a kk * qBinomial q kk u = qBinomial q a u * qBinomial q (a - u) (kk - u)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq'
statement:
lemma qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq' {a kk u : ℕ} (hka : kk ≤ a) (hu : u ≤ kk)
    (hf : ∀ n, qFactorial q n ≠ 0) :
    qBinomial q a kk * qBinomial q kk u = qBinomial q a u * qBinomial q (a - u) (kk - u)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.square_deficit_le
statement:
theorem square_deficit_le (a b n t h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hw : 3 * a + b = 2 * n) :
    t / h - a / h - b / (3 * h) ≤ t / h - n / (3 * h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.square_floor_comparison
statement:
theorem square_floor_comparison (a b n h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hw : 3 * a + b = 2 * n) :
    n / (3 * h) ≤ a / h + b / (3 * h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.apply_cyclotomicBlocks
statement:
lemma apply_cyclotomicBlocks (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (u r : ℕ) (F : ℤ[X][X]) :
    applyBlocks (fun j ↦ cyclotomicBlock h hh (u + j * h))
      (newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) 0 u F) r =
        newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) 0 (u + r * h) F

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.linearFactors_eq
statement:
theorem linearFactors_eq (x : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hx : IsPrimitiveRoot x n) :
    linearFactors x n = 1 - (-X) ^ n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonFactors_block
statement:
theorem newtonFactors_block {x : R} {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hx : IsPrimitiveRoot x (3 * h)) (j : ℕ) :
    newtonFactors x j h = X ^ h - 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_add
statement:
lemma newtonOp_add (x : R) (j n m : ℕ) :
    newtonOp x j (n + m) = newtonOp x (j + n) m * newtonOp x j n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_block
statement:
theorem newtonOp_block {x : R} {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hx : IsPrimitiveRoot x (3 * h)) (j : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    newtonOp x j h F = -((-X) ^ (3 * h)) * F

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_map
statement:
lemma newtonOp_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (x : R)
    (j n : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    (newtonOp x j n F).map f = newtonOp (f x) j n (F.map f)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_preserves_X_dvd
statement:
lemma newtonOp_preserves_X_dvd (x : R) (j n m : ℕ) (F : R[X])
    (hF : X ^ m ∣ F) : X ^ m ∣ newtonOp x j n F

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_succ
statement:
lemma newtonOp_succ (x : R) (j n : ℕ) :
    newtonOp x j (n + 1) =
      (shift x ^ 3 - x ^ (3 * (j + n)) • 1) * newtonOp x j n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_zero
statement: lemma newtonOp_zero (x : R) (j : ℕ) : newtonOp x j 0 = 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonPolynomial_succ
statement:
lemma newtonPolynomial_succ (t : ℕ) :
    newtonPolynomial (t + 1) =
      (1 + X) * (1 + C (X : ℤ[X]) * X) * (1 + C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ 2) * X) *
        (newtonPolynomial t).comp (C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ 3) * X) -
          C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * t)) * newtonPolynomial t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonPolynomial_zero
statement: lemma newtonPolynomial_zero : newtonPolynomial 0 = 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.primitive_cube
statement:
lemma primitive_cube {x : R} {h : ℕ} (hx : IsPrimitiveRoot x (3 * h)) :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (x ^ 3) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_apply
statement:
lemma shift_apply (x : R) (F : R[X]) :
    shift x F = (1 + X) * F.comp (C x * X)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_cube_apply
statement:
lemma shift_cube_apply (x : R) (F : R[X]) :
    (shift x ^ 3) F = (1 + X) * (1 + C x * X) * (1 + C (x ^ 2) * X) *
      F.comp (C (x ^ 3) * X)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_pow_apply
statement:
lemma shift_pow_apply (x : R) (n : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    (shift x ^ n) F = linearFactors x n * F.comp (C (x ^ n) * X)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_pow_map
statement:
lemma shift_pow_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (x : R)
    (n : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    ((shift x ^ n) F).map f = (shift (f x) ^ n) (F.map f)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_pow_preserves_X_dvd
statement:
lemma shift_pow_preserves_X_dvd (x : R) (n m : ℕ) (F : R[X])
    (hF : X ^ m ∣ F) : X ^ m ∣ (shift x ^ n) F

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.cyclotomic_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma cyclotomic_emultiplicity (d e : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (cyclotomic e ℤ) = if d = e then 1 else 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.factorial_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma factorial_emultiplicity (n d : ℕ) (hd : 1 < d) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (progressionProduct 1 n) = (n / d : ℕ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.gaussian_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma gaussian_emultiplicity (d m : ℕ) (hd : 1 < d) (hm : 0 < m) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (gaussian m) = if d ∣ m then 1 else 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.gaussian_ne_zero
statement: lemma gaussian_ne_zero (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : gaussian m ≠ 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.prime_dvd_progressionProduct
LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.progressionProduct_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma progressionProduct_emultiplicity (k n d : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hd : 1 < d) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (progressionProduct k n) =
      (#{i ∈ range n | d ∣ k * (i + 1)} : ℕ∞)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.progressionProduct_ne_zero
statement:
lemma progressionProduct_ne_zero (k n : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    progressionProduct k n ≠ 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.tripleProduct_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma tripleProduct_emultiplicity (n h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic (3 * h) ℤ) (progressionProduct 3 n) = (n / h : ℕ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.tripleProduct_emultiplicity_of_not_dvd
statement:
lemma tripleProduct_emultiplicity_of_not_dvd (n d : ℕ) (hd : 1 < d) (h3 : ¬3 ∣ d) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (progressionProduct 3 n) = (n / d : ℕ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_boundary
statement:
lemma hermite_boundary (x z : R) (b : ℕ) :
    (1 - (x * z) ^ 2 * x ^ b) * hermite x (x * z) b -
      (1 - x * z) * hermite x z (b + 1) -
      (x * z) ^ 3 * (1 - x ^ (2 * b)) * hermite x (x * z) (b - 1) -
      (x * z) ^ 4 * x ^ b * (1 - x ^ (b - 1)) * (1 - x ^ b) *
        hermite x (x * z) (b - 2) = 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_identities
statement:
lemma hermite_identities (x z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (hermite x (x * z) (n + 1) = x ^ (n + 1) * hermite x z (n + 1) +
      (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) * hermite x (x * z) n) ∧
    (hermite x z (n + 1) =
      (1 + x * z + x ^ 2 * z ^ 2) * hermite x (x * z) n -
        x ^ (n + 2) * z ^ 2 * hermite x z n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_newton
statement:
lemma hermite_newton (x z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    hermite x z (n + 1) =
      (1 + x * z + x ^ 2 * z ^ 2) * hermite x (x * z) n -
        x ^ (n + 2) * z ^ 2 * hermite x z n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_one
statement: @[simp] lemma hermite_one (x z : R) : hermite x z 1 = 1 + x * z

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_shift
statement:
lemma hermite_shift (x z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    hermite x (x * z) (n + 1) = x ^ (n + 1) * hermite x z (n + 1) +
      (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) * hermite x (x * z) n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_step
statement:
lemma hermite_step (x z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    hermite x z (n + 2) = (1 + x ^ (n + 2) * z) * hermite x z (n + 1) +
      x ^ (n + 2) * (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) * z ^ 2 * hermite x z n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma hermite_zero (x z : R) : hermite x z 0 = 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.residual_c
statement:
lemma residual_c (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) :
    residual x a b (c + 1) = residual x a (b + 1) c +
      x ^ (a + b + 2 * c + 2) * residual x a b c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.residual_eq_zero
statement: lemma residual_eq_zero (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) : residual x a b c = 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.residual_zero_right
statement: lemma residual_zero_right (x : R) (a b : ℕ) : residual x a b 0 = 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPoly_a
statement:
lemma scalarPoly_a (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) :
    scalarPoly x (a + 1) b c = scalarPoly x a (b + 1) c +
      x ^ (2 * a + b + c + 2) * scalarPoly x a b c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPoly_c
statement:
lemma scalarPoly_c (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) :
    scalarPoly x a b (c + 1) = scalarPoly x a (b + 1) c +
      x ^ (a + b + 2 * c + 2) * scalarPoly x a b c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPoly_last_zero
statement:
lemma scalarPoly_last_zero (x : R) (a b : ℕ) :
    scalarPoly x a b 0 = triple x a * hermite x (x ^ a) b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPoly_symm
statement:
lemma scalarPoly_symm (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) :
    scalarPoly x a b c = scalarPoly x c b a

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPolynomial_recurrence
statement:
theorem scalarPolynomial_recurrence (a b c : ℕ) :
    gaussian (2 * a + b + c) * scalarPolynomial a b c =
      gaussian (3 * a) * scalarPolynomial (a - 1) (b + 1) c +
      (1 - X) * X ^ (3 * a) * gaussian (b - 1) * gaussian b *
        scalarPolynomial a (b - 2) (c + 1) +
      X ^ (3 * a + b - 1) * (1 + X) * gaussian b * scalarPolynomial a (b - 1) c +
      X ^ (3 * a + 2 * b) * gaussian (3 * c) * scalarPolynomial a b (c - 1)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPolynomial_zero
statement: lemma scalarPolynomial_zero : scalarPolynomial 0 0 0 = 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_mul_X
statement:
lemma newtonOp_mul_X (x : R) (t : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    newtonOp x 0 (t + 1) (X * F) =
      x ^ (3 * t) • (X * (x ^ 3 • ((shift x ^ 3) (newtonOp x 0 t F)) -
        newtonOp x 0 t F))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_succ_start_mul_X
statement:
lemma newtonOp_succ_start_mul_X (x : R) (j t : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    newtonOp x (j + 1) t (X * F) = x ^ (3 * t) • (X * newtonOp x j t F)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonPolynomial_dilation
statement:
theorem newtonPolynomial_dilation (t : ℕ) :
    (1 + X) * (newtonPolynomial (t + 1)).comp (C (X : ℤ[X]) * X) =
      (1 + C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1))) * X) * newtonPolynomial (t + 1) +
        C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * t)) *
          (C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1))) - 1) * X * newtonPolynomial t

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_recurrence
statement:
theorem squarePolynomial_recurrence (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n)
    (hnt : n ≤ 3 * t + 2) :
    gaussian (n + 1) * squarePolynomial (n + 1) (t + 1) =
      (X : ℤ[X]) ^ n * gaussian (3 * (n - t)) * squarePolynomial n (t + 1) +
        X ^ (3 * t) * gaussian (3 * t + 2 - n) * gaussian (3 * t + 1 - n) *
          squarePolynomial n t

statement:
lemma exists_descent : ∀ w : List (Fin n), ¬ w.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) →
    ∃ p a b s, a < b ∧ w = p ++ b :: a :: s
  | [], h => absurd List.Pairwise.nil h
  | c :: w, h => by
    by_cases hw : w.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)
    · obtain ⟨d, hd, hcd⟩ : ∃ d ∈ w, ¬ c ≤ d

LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.mono_insert
statement:
lemma mono_insert : ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → B) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (a : Fin n),
    (∀ i < a, c i = 0) → x a * mono x c = mono x (Function.update c a (c a + 1))
  | 0, _, _, a, _ => a.elim0
  | n + 1, x, c, a, hc => by
    have hsplit (d : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) :
        mono x d = x 0 ^ d 0 * mono (fun i ↦ x i.succ) (fun i ↦ d i.succ)

    ∃ n : ℕ, (∀ i ≤ n, (T ^ i) m ≠ 0) ∧ (T ^ (n + 1)) m = 0 ∧

theorem invCoeff_mul_simple {w : W} {i : B} (hlt : ℓ w < ℓ (w * s i)) (y : W) :
    invCoeff cs hq y (w * s i) = if ℓ (y * s i) < ℓ y then hq.unit⁻¹.1 * invCoeff cs hq (y * s i) w
      else invCoeff cs hq (y * s i) w - (1 - hq.unit⁻¹.1) * invCoeff cs hq y w

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.anticommutator
statement:
theorem anticommutator (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I) :
    (delta b s).comp (homotopy b s) + (homotopy b s).comp (delta b s) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id
        (∑ i ∈ s, (LinearMap.mulLeft R (MvPolynomial.X i)).comp
          (MvPolynomial.pderiv i).toLinearMap) +
      TensorProduct.map (exteriorNumber b s) LinearMap.id

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.anticommutator_basisWord
statement:
theorem anticommutator_basisWord (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (l : List I) (hl : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∈ s) (p : MvPolynomial I R) (n : ℕ)
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous n) (hs : p.vars ⊆ s) :
    delta b s (homotopy b s (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p)) +
      homotopy b s (delta b s (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p)) =
    (n + l.length) • (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p)

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.anticommutator_homogeneous

    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) :
    delta b s (homotopy b s z) + homotopy b s (delta b s z) = (n + q) • z

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.anticommutator_tmul

    delta b s (homotopy b s (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) +
      homotopy b s (delta b s (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) =
    e ⊗ₜ[R] (∑ i ∈ s, MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.pderiv i p) +
      exteriorNumber b s e ⊗ₜ[R] p

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deltaTerm_tmul (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i : I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R) :
    deltaTerm b i (e ⊗ₜ[R] p) = contract b i e ⊗ₜ[R] (MvPolynomial.X i * p)

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.delta_sq
statement:
theorem delta_sq (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I) :
    delta b s * delta b s = 0

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exteriorNumber_basisWord
statement:
theorem exteriorNumber_basisWord (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (l : List I) (hl : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∈ s) :
    exteriorNumber b s (basisWord b l) = l.length • basisWord b l

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exteriorNumber_wedge
statement:
theorem exteriorNumber_wedge (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (j : I) (hj : j ∈ s) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    exteriorNumber b s (wedge b j e) =
      wedge b j e + wedge b j (exteriorNumber b s e)

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.homotopyTerm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homotopyTerm_tmul (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i : I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R) :
    homotopyTerm b i (e ⊗ₜ[R] p) = wedge b i e ⊗ₜ[R] MvPolynomial.pderiv i p

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.term_anticommutator
statement:
theorem term_anticommutator (b : Module.Basis I R M) [DecidableEq I] (i j : I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R) :
    deltaTerm b i (homotopyTerm b j (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) +
      homotopyTerm b j (deltaTerm b i (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) =
    if i = j then e ⊗ₜ[R] (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.pderiv i p) +
      wedge b i (contract b i e) ⊗ₜ[R] p else 0

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.wedge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wedge_apply (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i : I) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    wedge b i e = ι R (b i) * e

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.wedge_contract_wedge
statement:
theorem wedge_contract_wedge (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i j : I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    wedge b i (contract b i (wedge b j e)) =
      b.coord i (b j) • wedge b i e + wedge b j (wedge b i (contract b i e))

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.wedge_wedge
statement:
theorem wedge_wedge (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i j : I) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    wedge b i (wedge b j e) = -(wedge b j (wedge b i e))

statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_cycle_polynomial_degree_zero (b : Module.Basis I K M) (s : Finset I)
    (q : ℕ) (z : ExteriorAlgebra K M ⊗[K] MvPolynomial I K)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s 0 q) (hcycle : delta b s z = 0)
    (hq : 0 < q) : z = 0

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exists_homogeneous_primitive
statement:
theorem exists_homogeneous_primitive (b : Module.Basis I K M) (s : Finset I) (n q : ℕ)
    (z : ExteriorAlgebra K M ⊗[K] MvPolynomial I K)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) (hcycle : delta b s z = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < n + q) :
    ∃ y ∈ homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1), delta b s y = z

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.homotopy_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree_zero

statement:

    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) :
    homotopy b s z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1)

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.normalized_homotopy_primitive
statement:
theorem normalized_homotopy_primitive (b : Module.Basis I K M) (s : Finset I) (n q : ℕ)
    (z : ExteriorAlgebra K M ⊗[K] MvPolynomial I K)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) (hcycle : delta b s z = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < n + q) :
    ((n + q : ℕ) : K)⁻¹ • homotopy b s z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1) ∧
      delta b s (((n + q : ℕ) : K)⁻¹ • homotopy b s z) = z

name: Tengoku.LieLean.Crystal.map_stringMap_of_bind₂
statement:
lemma map_stringMap_of_bind₂ {a c : ι'}
    (he : ∀ b, (C.e k b).map Φ = (C'.e c (Φ b)).bind (C'.e a))
    (hf : ∀ b, (C.f k b).map Φ = (C'.f c (Φ b)).bind (C'.f a))
    (hee : ∀ x, (C'.e c x).bind (C'.e a) = (C'.e a x).bind (C'.e c))
    (hff : ∀ x, (C'.f c x).bind (C'.f a) = (C'.f a x).bind (C'.f c)) (n : ℤ) (b : B) :
    (C.stringMap k n b).map Φ = (C'.stringMap c n (Φ b)).bind (C'.stringMap a n)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.Crystal.map_stringMap_of_bind₃
statement:
lemma map_stringMap_of_bind₃ {a c d : ι'}
    (he : ∀ b, (C.e k b).map Φ = ((C'.e d (Φ b)).bind (C'.e c)).bind (C'.e a))
    (hf : ∀ b, (C.f k b).map Φ = ((C'.f d (Φ b)).bind (C'.f c)).bind (C'.f a))
    (hee : ∀ x, (C'.e d x).bind (C'.e c) = (C'.e c x).bind (C'.e d))
    (hff : ∀ x, (C'.f d x).bind (C'.f c) = (C'.f c x).bind (C'.f d))
    (hee' : ∀ x, (C'.e d x).bind (C'.e a) = (C'.e a x).bind (C'.e d))
    (hff' : ∀ x, (C'.f d x).bind (C'.f a) = (C'.f a x).bind (C'.f d))
    (hee'' : ∀ x, (C'.e c x).bind (C'.e a) = (C'.e a x).bind (C'.e c))
    (hff'' : ∀ x, (C'.f c x).bind (C'.f a) = (C'.f a x).bind (C'.f c)) (n : ℤ) (b : B) :
    (C.stringMap k n b).map Φ =
      ((C'.stringMap d n (Φ b)).bind (C'.stringMap c n)).bind (C'.stringMap a n)

name: Tengoku.LieLean.Crystal.map_stringMap_of_eq

theorem fw_eq_of_fw_stretchWord_eq (hm : 0 < m) {w w' : List ι}
    (h : K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w')) : K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w'

name: Tengoku.LieLean.Crystal.KSData.fw_stretchWord_and_ε
statement:
theorem fw_stretchWord_and_ε (hm : 0 < m) (L : ℕ) :
    (∀ w : List ι, w.length ≤ L →
      ∀ k, C'.ε k (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = m • C.ε k (K.fw hD w)) ∧
    (∀ w w' : List ι, w.length ≤ L → w'.length ≤ L → K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w' →
      K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w')) ∧
    (∀ w w' : List ι, w.length ≤ L → w'.length ≤ L →
      K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w') → K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w')

    K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w')
